title: Getting started with qteasy-ai
summary: Install qteasy, set a local AI home, then Ask concepts or Plan a read-only task.
narrative:
Getting started: (1) install qteasy and qteasy-ai in the same Python env; (2) optionally set QTEASY_AI_HOME; (3) run `qteasy-ai ask "what is qteasy"` for concepts; (4) `qteasy-ai plan "list built-in strategies"` to review a ToolPlan without executing skills.

For data work, check Tushare / local tables first, then Plan a bounded download with explicit dates. Do not run unbounded refill.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
print(assistant.ask('getting started', response_style='raw')['answer'][:200])
print(assistant.plan('list built-in strategies', response_style='raw')['plan']['steps'][0]['skill_name'])
risk_notes: First-run refill without dates is rejected. Confirm side-effects before run.
